title: OrderItemGroup - Data API
description: Stores the group information for line items in an order. It also stores the aggregated line field information (subtotal). It contains a parent-child relationship to order. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OrderId.description: ID of the order that this order product is a child of. This field is a relationship field.

SegmentType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SegmentType.description: The duration type of the segment. You can use this field from Revenue Cloud only when the Ramp Deals for Groups in Quotes and Orders setting is turned on. Valid values are: Custom—Available in API version 65.0 and later. Prorated—Available in API version 67.0 and later. Trial—Available in API version 67.0 and later. Yearly—Available in API version 65.0 and later. The default value is Yearly.

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: Number indicating the sort order selected by the user.

StartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

SummarySubtotal.description: The total amount of all the line items in the group.

Type.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: The type of the group. Possible values are: CPQOrderGroup—CPQ Line Grouping The default value is CPQOrderGroup.

UnitPriceUplift.description: The percentage increase of the order item group's unit price.
